replay.reason: Showcase database recovery and retry reconciliation

recovery.verification: Consumer offsets did not advance during the outage. Every acknowledged input was archived after recovery. Replaying decisions preserved one logical result per payment.

reconciliation.scope: Acknowledged inputs and generated payments in this run

provenance.verification: Every acknowledged Kafka coordinate and payload hash archived; exactly one matching logical decision per generated payment.
